title: Calculation and Normalization of Relative Gene Abundance
author: Fan Wei
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bpivmke6

steps.title: Build BWA index for gene catalog
steps.instruction: Create a BWA index for the gene catalog FASTA file MGCA_gene_Catalog.fasta using the command `bwa index ./MGCA_gene_Catalog.fasta`.

steps.title: Map paired reads to gene catalog
steps.instruction: Align each clean read file to the indexed gene catalog with BWA‑MEM using 20 threads, redirect stderr to a log file, pipe the SAM output through gzip, and save as compressed SAM files.

steps.title: Calculate mapping statistics and abundance
steps.instruction: Execute the Perl script bwa_mapping_stat.pl on the two compressed SAM files, specify the output file, and capture any error messages in a log.

steps.title: Extract gene IDs and normalized abundances
steps.instruction: From the output file generated by the previous step (abc.clean.fq.gz.sam.gz..mapping.abundance), select the first and last columns, which represent the gene identifier and its normalized relative abundance.
